statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a recent transient ischemic attack
The service is to capture intermittent arrhythmias and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The service is to guide anticoagulation and rate control management
The diagnosis codes are I48.91, G45.9, and R42
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to service delivery
